gloss: to pay attention; to exercise caution

definitions.gloss: to pay attention; to exercise caution; to take care
definitions.explanation: To be careful and attentive about something. More deliberate and formal than simply 気をつける. The verb 払う (to pay) is used metaphorically here, as in English "to pay attention."

examples.japanese: ⟦{細部|さいぶ}→細部：20562_saibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う。
⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}うべきだ。
examples.english: You should pay more attention to your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sufficient care must be taken in handling personal information.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay attention to ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay sufficient attention)
- {細心|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay the closest attention; to exercise utmost care)
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (it is necessary to pay attention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: To be careful — more casual and common in everyday speech.
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To be careful, to warn — simpler and broader. {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う is more deliberate and formal.
- ⟦{用心|ようじん}→用心：03659_youjin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To be cautious, to take precautions — focuses on preventive measures against danger.
